title: The Forminator Forms WordPress plugin before 1.58.4 does not verify that a Stripe Checkout payment has completed…
description: The Forminator Forms WordPress plugin versions before 1.58.4 have a vulnerability where the plugin does not verify that a Stripe Checkout payment has completed before returning the post-payment redirect URL and thank-you message. This allows unauthenticated visitors to access payment-gated form responses without actually paying.
